speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please describe the specific joints that are painful and how long you have been experiencing this chronic pain?

speaker: Patient
text: I have pain in my left big toe, hips, and knees that has been getting progressively worse over the past several years. The discomfort tends to flare up when I am active but usually subsides when I rest. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the chronic, progressive nature of your pain in weight-bearing joints like the hips, knees, and big toe, which worsens with activity and improves with rest, this pattern is highly characteristic of osteoarthritis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteoarthritis
